_readme: Panchang golden cases (ADR-008, PR-9). Content fills `cases` from two published panchangs. tithiIndex 0-29 (0 = Shukla Pratipada, 14 = Purnima, 15 = Krishna Pratipada, 29 = Amavasya) at local sunrise; nakshatraIndex 0-26 (0 = Ashwini) at local sunrise; sunrise/sunset HH:MM local. cityId from src/lib/cities.ts. Extra fields (tithiName, paksha, nakshatraName, masaIndex 0-11 with 0 = Chaitra amanta, masaPurnimanta, transitions) are for people and may be ignored by the test.

sources.name: Drik Panchang (month panchang and day panchang, per city geoname id: Pune 1259229, Mumbai 1275339, New Delhi 1261481, Varanasi 1253405, Chennai 1264527)
Prokerala daily panchang (default location Ujjain; transition times are in IST and do not depend on city)

_provenance.method: Tithi, nakshatra and month: both sources agree on every transition time to within 1 minute. Every chosen date has its transitions at least 1 hour 40 minutes away from sunrise in all 5 cities, so the value at sunrise is the same in every city and is not sensitive to small timing differences. Dates near a transition (e.g. 20 Nov, 9 Dec) were deliberately left out. Sunrise and sunset: Drik Panchang per city (Prokerala gives Ujjain only). As an independent check, all 100 times were compared with the NOAA solar formula (zenith 90.833 deg) and all are within 1 minute.
